sb.name: Adult Giant Antlion
sb.senses: blindsight 15 ft., tremorsense 120 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 15

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: The antlion has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

traits.name: Burrowed Camouflage
traits.desc: While it is at least partially burrowed, the antlion has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in sand or loose earth.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.desc: If the antlion surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 26 (4d12) damage from the attack.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.desc: The antlion has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

traits.name: Antlion Cone
traits.desc: The antlion can spend 10 minutes digging a cone-shaped pit in the sand, or some other loose earth. The cone is 30 feet deep and 60 feet across, and the sides are steep enough that the loose earth they are made with is a falling hazard. A standing creature that moves within the cone (even if by forced movement) for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A creature that falls prone while within the cone rolls to the bottom.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The antlion makes three attacks: one with its bite, and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends the antlion can't bite another target or use its sand throw, and if the target is a creature, it is restrained.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 feet., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sand Throw
actions.desc: One creature the antlion can sense within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Snapping Jaws
reactions.desc: When a creature the antlion can sense moves to within the reach of the antlion's bite and the antlion is not grappling a creature, it can make a bite attack against that creature.

sb.name: Alceton
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
sb.languages: Giant Elk understands Common and Elvish but can't speak them

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the alceton moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.desc: The alceton has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The alceton makes two attacks: one with its ram and one with its talons.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature that is prone, it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the alceton can't use its talons on another target.

sb.name: Ale Elemental
sb.damage_resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, drunkenness|GriffonsSaddlebag2, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Alcohol Form
traits.desc: The elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Freeze
traits.desc: If the elemental takes cold damage, it partially freezes; its speed is reduced by 20 feet until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Variant: Wine Elemental
traits.desc:
Taking the form of bubbling liquids of various colors, wine elementals are a more potent and rare version of the ale elemental. More intelligent and attuned to nature than their fellows, their appearance is usually in reaction to the destruction of nature.. Bacchanalian parties that damage the environment often attract their ire, resulting in many party-goers getting far more than they reckoned. Whatever their perceived or actual motivations, these elementals are a formidable force and especially dangerous for those with a low tolerance for alcohol. A wine elemental has the same statistics as an ale elemental, with the following changes: • Its Intelligence and Charisma scores increase to 10 (+0). • It can speak Druidic. • It replaces the Freeze trait with the Partial Freeze trait (detailed below). • While a creature is grappled by the elemental's Whelm, it gains two levels of drunkenness if it fails the Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the elemental's turns, and one level if it succeeds.

- **Partial Freeze.** If the elemental takes 10 cold damage or more during a single turn, it partially freezes. Until the end of its next turn, its speed is reduced by 20 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Whelm (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: Each creature in the elemental's space must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If it is Large or smaller, it is also grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water. If the saving throw is successful, the target is pushed out of the elemental's space. The elemental can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at one time. At the start of each of the elemental's turns, each target grappled by it takes 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or gain one level of drunkenness. A creature within 5 feet of the elemental can pull a creature or object out of it by taking an action to make a DC 14 Strength check and succeeding. Any levels of drunkenness caused by this effect go away when the grapple ends.

sb.name: Analeptic Lizard
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
sb.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The lizard can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The lizard regains 1 hit point at the start of its turn. If the lizard takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The lizard dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The lizard can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Variant: Alternative Familiars
traits.desc:
Warlocks that have sworn a pact of the chain and align with the chaotic nature of Grihoo and Vaanor can occasionally bind a cerberus pup or analeptic lizard familiar. They typically prefer to bond with those who can provide for their physical and emotional needs—specifically high-enrichment activities like hunting with the pup or providing plenty of bugs for the lizard's diet. A cerberus pup or regenerative lizard serving as a familiar has the following trait.

- **Familiar.** At the GM's discretion, warlocks with the Pact of the Chain feature can choose a cerberus pup or regenerative lizard as their familiar, in addition to the forms listed in their class. While the two are bonded, the master can sense what the familiar senses as long as they are within 1 mile of each other. If its master causes it physical harm, the pup or lizard will end its service as a familiar, breaking the telepathic bond.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Invigorate (1/Day)
actions.desc: The lizard regains all its hit points. Until the start of its next turn, the lizard has resistance to all damage and advantage on all saving throws.

sb.name: Aqualisk
sb.senses: darkvision 120 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 21

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The aqualisk can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The aqualisk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The aqualisk's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The aqualisk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict. If it is grappling a creature, it can also use its Fling.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, that creature is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the aqualisk can't constrict another target.

actions.name: Ethereal Strike (1/Turn)
actions.desc: While on the Ethereal Plane, the aqualisk momentarily shifts to the Material Plane and makes a bite attack against a creature before returning to the Ethereal Plane. Unless the target can see into the Ethereal Plane, the aqualisk has advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: The aqualisk magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane. If a creature is grappled by the aqualisk when it uses this action, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be pulled into the Ethereal Plane with it. The aqualisk and target remain there as long as the aqualisk maintains concentration (as if concentrating on a spell). If its concentration is broken or it chooses to end its concentration, the aqualisk and the target both return to the Material Plane.

actions.name: Fling
actions.desc: One object held or creature grappled by the aqualisk is thrown up to 60 feet in a direction it chooses and knocked prone. If a thrown creature strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

sb.name: Archer Flower
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, prone, unconscious
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 9

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the flower remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal shrub.

traits.name: Rooted
traits.desc: The flower is unaffected by forced movement and can't be detached while it lives. If the flower is rooted to a wall or ceiling, it doesn't need to make ability checks to maintain its grip.

actions.name: Flytrap
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Acid Spit
actions.desc: One creature within 60 feet of the flower that the flower can see must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. A creature that fails its save takes 4 (1d8) acid damage and is knocked prone. If the creature is climbing, it instead loses its grip and falls. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much acid damage and suffers no other effects.

sb.name: Bardic Merchant
sb.languages: Common, plus up to two other languages

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The merchant is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). They know the following bard spells:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Mending|mending]], [[Tools/Spells/Message|message]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Comprehend Languages|comprehend languages]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Identify|identify]], [[Tools/Spells/Unseen Servant|unseen servant]]
- **2nd level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]]

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Magic Coin
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) thunder damage.

reactions.name: Chance (Recharge 5–6)
reactions.desc: When a creature within 60 feet of the merchant makes an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, the merchant flips a coin. If it's heads, the creature can roll a d6 and add the number rolled to the d20. If it's tails, one random creature within 60 feet of the merchant gains a d6, which it can roll and add to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
traits.desc: The treant is immune to the diseases described in the Bloodmire Diseases table.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the treant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal Bloodmire tree.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The treant makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Mudball
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target's speed is halved until the start of the treant's next turn.

actions.name: Animate Blood (2/Day)
actions.desc: The treant magically animates a pool of blood it can see within 60 feet of it. The blood congeals into a viscous form and has the statistics of a gelatinous cube, except its Ooze Cube, Pseudopod, and Engulf trait and action options deal necrotic damage instead of acid damage, and its Transparent trait doesn't function unless it's in blood or bloodwater. The animated blood acts as an ally of the treant. The blood remains animate for 8 hours or until it dies; until the treant dies or is more than 120 feet from the blood; or until the treant takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate pool of blood.

sb.name: Bramble Creeper
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, prone, unconscious
sb.senses: tremorsense 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 8

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: The creeper has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the creeper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from normal cluster of vines.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The creeper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Thorns
traits.desc: At the start of each of its turns, the creeper deals 7 (2d6) piercing damage to any creature grappling it, or that it has grappled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The creeper makes two attacks with its strangling bramble. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

actions.name: Strangling Bramble
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Large or smaller target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and at risk of suffocating. If the creeper is grappling a Large creature, or two Medium or smaller creatures, it can't use this attack against another creature.

sb.name: Brimstone Drake
sb.speed: 40 ft., burrow 20 ft., fly 40 ft., swim 40 ft.
sb.senses: darkvision 120 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 12
sb.languages: understands Abyssal, Draconic, and Infernal but can't speak

traits.name: Heated Body
traits.desc: A creature that touches the drake or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

traits.name: Stench
traits.desc: Any creature other than a brimstone drake that starts its turn within 10 feet of the drake must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of all brimstone drakes for 1 hour.

traits.name: Volcanic Acclimation
traits.desc: Ash, dust, fog, and other particles suspended in the air don't impede the drake's vision, and it can breathe normally in ash and under lava.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The drake makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its claws, and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) fire damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Ashen Eruption (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The drake exhales a cloud of electrically charged ash in a 30-foot cone, creating an area that is heavily obscured until the end of the drake's next turn. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 35 (10d6) lightning damage and is blinded until the end of the drake's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.

sb.name: Butcher Dray, Three-Headed Ettin
sb.damage_resistances: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Hungering Frenzy
traits.desc: When Dray scores a critical hit with a weapon attack or reduces a creature to 0 hit points, his spell save DC increases to 23 and he has advantage on all attack rolls until the end of his next turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Dray fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Dray has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Dray's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Three Heads
traits.desc: Dray has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration on spells.

traits.name: Touch of Death
traits.desc: When damage Dray deals reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it automatically suffers one death saving throw failure.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.desc: When one of Dray's heads is asleep, his other heads are awake. In addition, magic can't put him to sleep.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Dray's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks). Dray can innately cast any cleric cantrip as a 20th-level spellcaster, as well as the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|bestow curse]], [[Tools/Spells/Blindness/Deafness|blindness/deafness]] (as a 4th-level spell)
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Harm|harm]], [[Tools/Spells/Heal|heal]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Divine Word|divine word]], [[Tools/Spells/Resurrection|resurrection]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Dray makes two attacks: one with his fist and one with his dagger.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (6d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on DC 22 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Ritual Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (6d4 + 7) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Dray regains hit points equal to half that amount. The reduction lasts for 1 hour. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

legendary_actions.name: Cantrip
legendary_actions.desc: Dray casts a cantrip.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Dray moves up to half his speed.

legendary_actions.name: Punch
legendary_actions.desc: Dray makes one fist attack.

legendary_actions.name: Summon Minions (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Dray magically summons (2d4) orcs or 1 ogre. A summoned creature appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Dray and acts as his ally. It remains for 1 minute, until it or Dray dies, or until Dray dismisses it as an action.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.desc: On each of its turns, the agent can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the agent is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the agent instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Expert Cartography
traits.desc: The agent has a +3 bonus to any ability check it makes using cartographer's tools, in addition to the ability modifier used for the check.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: The agent deals an extra 21 (6d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the agent that isn't incapacitated and the agent doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The agent makes two attacks with its dagger.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4+ 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: The agent halves the damage that it takes from an attack that hits it. The agent must be able to see the attacker.

sb.name: Cerberus Pup
sb.damage_resistances: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Three Heads
traits.desc: The cerberus pup has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, deafened, and stunned.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.desc: When one of the cerberus pup's heads is asleep, its other heads are awake. In addition, magic can't put it to sleep.

traits.name: Variant: Alternative Familiars
traits.desc:
Warlocks that have sworn a pact of the chain and align with the chaotic nature of Grihoo and Vaanor can occasionally bind a cerberus pup or analeptic lizard familiar. They typically prefer to bond with those who can provide for their physical and emotional needs—specifically high-enrichment activities like hunting with the pup or providing plenty of bugs for the lizard's diet. A cerberus pup or regenerative lizard serving as a familiar has the following trait.

- **Familiar.** At the GM's discretion, warlocks with the Pact of the Chain feature can choose a cerberus pup or regenerative lizard as their familiar, in addition to the forms listed in their class. While the two are bonded, the master can sense what the familiar senses as long as they are within 1 mile of each other. If its master causes it physical harm, the pup or lizard will end its service as a familiar, breaking the telepathic bond.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The cerberus pup makes three attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hellfire Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The cerberus pup exhales debilitating fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3 (1d6) fire damage and 3 (1d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

sb.name: Chantelle Redcliff, Mercantile Guildmaster
sb.languages: Common, plus up to three other languages

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Chantelle wears a dress of many pockets and has a book of instant copying and wand of gilding, which are all described in appendix A.

traits.name: Silver Tongue (Recharges After a Short or Long Rest)
traits.desc: When Chantelle makes a Charisma check or saving throw, she can choose to make the roll with advantage.

traits.name: Wand of Gilding
traits.desc: The wand has 7 charges and regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, Chantelle can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save DC 15) from it: [[Tools/Spells/Alter Self|alter self]], [[Tools/Spells/Charm Person|charm person]] (2nd-level version), [[Tools/Spells/Enthrall|enthrall]], or [[Tools/Spells/Hypnotic Pattern|hypnotic pattern]].

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Chantelle is a 14th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). She knows the following bard spells:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Mending|mending]], [[Tools/Spells/Message|message]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Comprehend Languages|comprehend languages]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Identify|identify]], [[Tools/Spells/Unseen Servant|unseen servant]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Knock|knock]], [[Tools/Spells/Locate Object|locate object]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Clairvoyance|clairvoyance]], [[Tools/Spells/Glyph Of Warding|glyph of warding]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|sending]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Fabricate|fabricate]], [[Tools/Spells/Phantasmal Killer|phantasmal killer]], [[Tools/Spells/Leomund'S Secret Chest|secret chest]]
- **5th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Geas|geas]], [[Tools/Spells/Legend Lore|legend lore]]
- **6th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Drawmij'S Instant Summons|instant summons]]
- **7th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Mordenkainen'S Sword|arcane sword]]

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Magic Coin
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) thunder damage.

actions.name: Money Talks (4/Day)
actions.desc: Chantelle enchants a coin in her hand with divination magic, which lasts for 10 minutes or until Chantelle ends the effect early (no action required). For the duration, a creature holding the coin that knows at least one language can understand the meaning of any word Chantelle speaks, and when Chantelle speaks, that creature understands what Chantelle says. Alternatively, Chantelle can use an action to see and hear through the enchanted coin until the start of her next turn, using her own senses as if she were in the coin's space. During this time, Chantelle is deaf and blind with regard to her own senses.

reactions.name: Chance (Recharge 4–6)
reactions.desc: When a creature within 60 feet of Chantelle makes an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, Chantelle flips a coin. If it's heads, the creature can roll a d12 and add the number rolled to the d20. If it's tails, one random creature within 60 feet of the merchant gains a d12, which it can roll and add to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The toad can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Corrosive Mucus
traits.desc: Any creature that touches the toad or hits it with a melee attack takes 5 (1d10) acid damage.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: The toad's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.desc: The toad has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

traits.name: Tongue Barb Regrowth
traits.desc: The toad has eighteen tongue barbs. Used barbs regrow when the toad finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tongue Barb

sb.name: Crimson Legion Imp
sb.damage_resistances: cold, necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

traits.desc: The imp can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a giant rat (speed 30 ft.), a blood hawk (10 ft., fly 60 ft.), or a giant centipede (30 ft., climb 30 ft.), or back into its true form. traits.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
traits.desc: The imp is immune to the diseases described in the Bloodmire Diseases table.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the imp's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The imp has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the imp's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Sting (Bite or Beak in Beast Form)

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The imp magically turns invisible until it attacks or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the imp wears or carries is invisible with it.

sb.name: Cyglops
sb.senses: blindsight 5 ft., darkvision 30 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Ooze Ancestry
traits.desc: The cyglops doesn't need to breathe. The cyglops doesn't require sleep, gaining the benefits of a long rest after spending 4 hours in a trance-like state. The cyglops has advantage on saving throws against disease.

traits.name: Poor Depth Perception
traits.desc: The cyglops has disadvantage on any attack roll against a target more than 30 feet away.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The cyglops makes two pseudopod attacks and uses its eye ray, if recharged. The eye ray can be replaced by its Release Skeletons action.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) acid damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet from the cyglops and knocked prone.

actions.name: Eye Ray (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Release Skeletons
actions.desc: The cyglops ejects 1d3 sets of skeletal remains from inside itself to an unoccupied space it can see within 10 feet of it, losing 4 (1d8) hit points for each one. The remains then animate, each becoming a skeleton loyal to the cyglops. Each skeleton remains for up to 1 hour, or until the cyglops reabsorbs it as an action. All skeletons created this way share one turn in combat, which takes place immediately following the cyglops in initiative.

sb.name: Death Coach
sb.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The death coach can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the death coach fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The death coach has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Silencing Aura
traits.desc: The area within 60 feet of the death coach is under the effects of a [[Tools/Spells/Silence|silence]] spell. The death coach is immune to this effect.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.desc: If the death coach moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the death coach can make another attack with its hooves against the target as a bonus action.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The death coach's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20. The death coach can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Blindness/Deafness|blindness/deafness]], [[Tools/Spells/Command|command]] (as a 2nd-level spell)
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|bestow curse]], [[Tools/Spells/Blight|blight]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Finger Of Death|finger of death]], [[Tools/Spells/Power Word Kill|power word kill]]

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) force damage.

actions.name: Etherealness (Ghost)
actions.desc: The death coach enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: The death coach moves up to its speed.

legendary_actions.name: Dreadful Presence (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Each creature of the death coach's choice that is within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target's speed is also reduced to 0 until this frightened effect ends for it. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the death coach's Dreadful Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The death coach casts a spell.

sb.legendary_description: The death coach can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The death coach regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

sb.name: Desert Cat

sb.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 13

traits.name: Desert Camouflage
traits.desc: The desert cat has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.desc: The desert cat can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the desert cat doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.desc: The desert cat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Variant: Desert Cat Familiar
traits.desc:
Spellcasters who are particularly attuned to the elemental planes or are inherently familiar with the desert's dunes may occasionally find and bind a desert cat familiar, especially those spellcasters who embody the desert cat's curiosity and propensity for chaos. A bound desert cat's behavior is erratic and varies greatly depending on its master's influence. Desert cats also are exceptionally skilled at reaching otherwise difficult-to-reach locations to cause trouble, especially around precious gems and metals. A desert cat serving as a familiar has the following trait.

- **Familiar.** At the GM's discretion, warlocks with the Pact of the Chain feature can choose a desert cat as their familiar, in addition to the forms listed in their class. While the two are bonded, the master can sense what the desert cat senses as long as they are within 1 mile of each other. If its master causes it physical harm, the desert cat will end its service as a familiar, breaking the telepathic bond.

actions.name: Sand Step
actions.desc: The desert cat teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that contains dirt, sand, or other fine earth.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.desc: As a bonus action, the leader can magically turn invisible until the start of its next turn, or until it makes an attack or casts a spell.

traits.name: Variant: Durheim Leader with Lightseer's Gaze
traits.desc:
The lightseer's gaze is a precious and heavily guarded artifact within Durheim Monastery, originally worn by Lightseer Attiskin. He left explicit provision that only in times of dire need should the mantle of Lightseer be taken up. Wearing the lightseer's gaze causes blindness, but the stars and celestial bodies in the heavens are still visible. The mysterious item also rewrites history, forcing the bearer to select a new name - only the bearer is aware that they ever had a different name. At the GM's discretion, a Durheim Leader can wield the lightseer's gaze, causing the following changes to its stat block: • It has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks. • It has blindsight out to a range of 120 feet, but is blind beyond this radius. • It gains the Innate Spellcasting trait below.

- **Innate Spellcasting.** The leader's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17). The leader can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components: 2/day: [[Tools/Spells/Spirit Guardians|spirit guardians]] 4/day: [[Tools/Spells/Calm Emotions|calm emotions]]

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The dyra can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.desc: Whenever the dyra takes damage while grappling a creature, the creature grappled by it also takes half the damage the dyra took.

traits.name: Lightning Susceptibility
traits.desc: If the dyra takes lightning damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of its next turn, and if it's grappling a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or the grapple ends.

traits.name: Metal Stride
traits.desc: While moving on a metallic object, structure, or surface, the dyra's speed is doubled.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The dyra can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dyra makes two pseudopod attacks.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). sb.name: Dyra Juggernaut

traits.name: Electrical Overload
traits.desc: If the dyra takes 25 lightning damage or more during a single turn, it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or become paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The dyra is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The dyra's weapon attacks are considered magical.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The dyra deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dyra uses its Electrostatic Discharge, if available. It then makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Electrostatic Discharge (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The dyra expels a burst of electricity in a 15-foot radius around itself. Each creature other than the dyra in the area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (8d6) lightning damage and is stunned until the end of the dyra's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

reactions.name: Voltaic Grounding
reactions.desc: When the dyra is subjected to lightning damage, it makes a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, it takes no damage instead and its Electrostatic Discharge immediately recharges if it wasn't already charged.

sb.name: Elder Lava Wurm
sb.speed: 30 ft., burrow 30 ft., fly 20 ft., swim 40 ft.
sb.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 15
sb.languages: understands Draconic, Ignan, and Terran but can't speak them

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The wurm can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Limited Flight
traits.desc: The wurm can only fly for up to 1 minute at a time. If it ends its turn in the air after 1 minute of consecutive flight and nothing else is holding it aloft, it falls.

traits.name: Noxious Resilience
traits.desc: The wurm has advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as the effects of a stinking cloud or a green dragon's poison breath).

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: The wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Volcanic Body
traits.desc: The wurm sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. In addition, whenever a creature enters the area within 10 feet of the wurm for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wurm makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Molten Spray (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The wurm exhales molten metal in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 38 (11d6) fire damage and its speed is reduced by 15 feet. If a target's speed is reduced to 0 by this effect, it becomes restrained. A creature can take an action to scrape or wash off the metal, ending the effect. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and its speed isn't reduced.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The fish can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.desc: The fish can see 30 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: The fish enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: The trickster enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

traits.name: Poison Resilience

traits.name: Strong Stomach (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.desc: While the battlechef is drunk, it can choose to magically suppress the alcohol's effects for 1 minute.

The battlechef is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Mending|mending]], [[Tools/Spells/Sacred Flame|sacred flame]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Bless|bless]], [[Tools/Spells/Goodberry|goodberry]], [[Tools/Spells/Purify Food And Drink|purify food and drink]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Heat Metal|heat metal]], [[Tools/Spells/Protection From Poison|protection from poison]], [[Tools/Spells/Spiritual Weapon|spiritual weapon]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Create Food And Water|create food and water]], [[Tools/Spells/Mass Healing Word|mass healing word]], [[Tools/Spells/Stinking Cloud|stinking cloud]]
- **4th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Blight|blight]], [[Tools/Spells/Control Water|control water]]

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Create Healing Draft (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The battlechef creates a magical potion in its free hand or at its feet (battlechef's choice). A creature that drinks this potion regains 15 (2d6 + 8) hit points. The potion turns to dust and is lost if the battlechef finishes a short or long rest before it is consumed.

reactions.name: Table-Turner (3/Day)
reactions.desc: When the battlechef is hit by an attack from a creature within 5 feet of it, the creature must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 6 (1d12) poison damage and is poisoned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned.

sb.name: Fleshcrafter
sb.damage_resistances: lightning, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Adamantine

traits.name: Flesh Bond
traits.desc: As long as the fleshcrafter and its flesh golem are within 120 feet of each other, the fleshcrafter can communicate with it telepathically. In addition, whenever the fleshcrafter casts a spell with a range of touch while within 120 feet of the golem, the golem can use its reaction to deliver the spell as if it had cast the spell, using the fleshcrafter's spell attack modifier and save DC. Whenever the fleshcrafter takes lightning damage, the golem regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Frenzy Control
traits.desc: While the fleshcrafter is alive and conscious, its flesh golem can't go berserk. If the fleshcrafter dies, its flesh golem immediately goes berserk.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The fleshcrafter is an 8th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Mending|mending]], [[Tools/Spells/Shocking Grasp|shocking grasp]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Alarm|alarm]], [[Tools/Spells/False Life|false life]], [[Tools/Spells/Tenser'S Floating Disk|Tenser's floating disk]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Alter Self|alter self]], [[Tools/Spells/Enlarge/Reduce|enlarge/reduce]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|bestow curse]], [[Tools/Spells/Haste|haste]], [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|lightning bolt]]
- **4th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Polymorph|polymorph]], [[Tools/Spells/Stoneskin|stoneskin]]

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

sb.name: Flintclaw
sb.languages: understands Abyssal and Infernal but can't speak them

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The flintclaw has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.desc: If the flintclaw moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the flintclaw can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Running Leap
traits.desc: The flintclaw's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The flintclaw makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

sb.name: Geleton Adventurer
sb.senses: blindsight 5 ft., darkvision 30 ft., passive Perception 11

traits.name: Dungeon Born
traits.desc: The geleton has advantage on any ability checks it makes to locate or identify hidden features of dungeons, such as traps or secret passageways.

traits.name: Ooze Ancestry
traits.desc: The geleton doesn't need to breathe. The geleton doesn't require sleep, gaining the benefits of a long rest after spending 4 hours in a trance-like state. The geleton has advantage on saving throws against disease.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The geleton makes two weapon attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

sb.name: Germination Stall
sb.senses: blindsight 150 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10
sb.languages: the languages its staff knew in life

traits.name: Alluring Affluence
traits.desc: Whenever a humanoid ends its turn within 60 feet of the stall, it must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has no hint that it is gradually falling under the effects of the stall's enchantment. If a creature succeeds on three of these saves, it is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours. If the creature fails three of these saves, it becomes charmed by the stall and must use all its movement on its turns to get as close to the stall as possible. The effect lasts for 24 hours or until the stall dies, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or ends the effect on the creature as a bonus action.

traits.name: Dedicated Staff
traits.desc: The stall comprises a staff of 5 (2d4) seed coin pollinators. This staff collectively shares the stall's Innate Spellcasting and Magic Resistance traits, they can't willingly move more than 150 feet away from the stall, and they seek to defend the stall at all costs, including to their own peril. Some of the stall's effects can use a member or members of its staff as the point of origin.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: The stall is indistinguishable from a normal merchant stall. However, a creature that has truesight sees a deep red aura radiating from the stall, and a creature within 30 feet of it that is under the effect of a [[Tools/Spells/Detect Poison And Disease|detect poison and disease]] spell senses the insidious nature of the stall and knows it is a plant creature.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The stall has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The stall doesn't require sleep. If the stall spends 1 hour in direct sunlight, it receives enough nourishment to sustain itself for one day. If the stall dies, it decomposes and is reduced to dirt within 7 days.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The stall's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). The stall can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Comprehend Languages|comprehend languages]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]], [[Tools/Spells/Unseen Servant|unseen servant]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Create Food And Water|create food and water]], [[Tools/Spells/Creation|creation]], [[Tools/Spells/Geas|geas]], [[Tools/Spells/Mass Suggestion|mass suggestion]]

actions.name: Enthralling Vines
actions.desc: The stall causes dark, creeping vines to protrude from itself and its staff, lashing out at creatures nearby. Each creature of the stall's choice within 10 feet of it or a member of its staff must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be restrained by the vines for 1 minute. While restrained in this way, a creature has disadvantage on saving throws against the stall's Alluring Affluence. A creature restrained by the vines can use its action to make a DC 14 Strength check, freeing itself on a success. These vines disappear if the stall dies, or if it uses this action again. It can also choose to end the effect early on any number of restrained creatures it chooses as a bonus action.

actions.name: Hostile Takeover
actions.desc: The stall attempts to magically compel one creature charmed by it that is within 5 feet of the stall or a member of its staff to swallow a seed coin. The target must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target swallows the coin and is subjected to the seed coin's Infestation. When subjected to the effect in this way, the diseased creature is killed in a number of hours equal to half its Wisdom score, unless the disease is removed. If the target successfully saves against this effect or the effect ends for it, it regurgitates the coin and is no longer charmed by the stall, and it is immune to the stall's Alluring Affluence for the next 24 hours.

sb.name: Ghost Dragon
sb.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 24

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.desc: The dragon can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The dragon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon can use its Horrifying Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Withering Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) necrotic damage, plus 5 (1d10) cold damage.

actions.name: Withering Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Withering Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Horrifying Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself of a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Horrifying Presence for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|greater restoration]] spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

actions.name: Chilling Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The dragon exhales deathly cold energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon makes a tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Etherealness (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (2d6 + 6) necrotic damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

sb.legendary_description: The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

sb.name: Giant Antlion Hatchling
sb.senses: blindsight 5 ft., tremorsense 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 13

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: The antlion has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

traits.name: Burrowed Camouflage
traits.desc: While it is at least partially burrowed, the antlion has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in sand or loose earth.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends the antlion can't bite another target.

reactions.name: Snapping Jaws
reactions.desc: While the antlion is benefiting from its Burrowed Camoflage and not grappling a creature, when a creature the antlion can sense moves into the antlion's space, it can make a bite attack against that creature.

traits.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
traits.desc: The eel is immune to the diseases described in the Bloodmire Diseases table.

traits.name: Water and Blood Breathing
traits.desc: The eel can breathe only underwater or under bloodwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The eel makes two bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

sb.name: Giant Horned Snake
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The snake can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the snake moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with its horns on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The snake makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its horns. It can use its constrict attack in place of one other attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and become poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the snake can't constrict another target.

actions.name: Horns
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage.

actions.name: Hypnotize (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The snake causes its horns to begin flashing with a dazzling array of colors. Each creature of the snake's choice within 60 feet of it that can see it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the snake for 1 minute. A charmed creature must spend each of its turns moving toward the snake by the shortest and most direct route. A charmed creature already within 5 feet of the snake doesn't move and takes no actions on its turn. While charmed in this way, the snake has advantage on attack rolls against the creature. If an affected creature takes any damage, or if another creature uses an action to shake the creature out of its trance, the creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
traits.desc: The mosquito is immune to the diseases described in the Bloodmire Diseases table.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) poison damage.

sb.name: Giant Spider Rat
sb.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The rat has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The rat can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 3 (1d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

traits.name: Flora Flit
traits.desc: Once on each of its turns, the lizard can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into any living flora (such as a plant, mold, or fungus) within 5 feet of it and emerge from a second living flora within 60 feet of it, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second flora. Both florae must be Medium or larger. If the lizard takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Nature Stride
traits.desc: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs the lizard no extra movement. It can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

traits.name: Organic Camouflage
traits.desc: The lizard has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in flora.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Retaliatory Spores
reactions.desc: When the lizard takes bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, it ejects a flurry of poisonous spores around itself. Each creature within 5 feet of the lizard must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 5 (2d4) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also poisoned until the end of its next turn.

sb.name: Grihoo, the Superhydra
sb.damage_immunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, poisoned, stunned, unconscious
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 300 ft., passive Perception 32

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: Grihoo can hold its breath indefinitely.

traits.name: Infinite Heads
traits.desc: Grihoo has an infinite number of heads. Whenever it takes 60 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. On its next turn, the number of attacks it makes as part of its Multiattack decreases by one (to a minimum of three) and it can't use its Snapping Frenzy. At the end of Grihoo's turn, it replaces all of its missing heads that died since its last turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.desc: If Grihoo fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Grihoo has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Grihoo's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.desc: Grihoo can take one reaction on every turn in a combat.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Grihoo makes five bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage.

actions.name: Snapping Frenzy
actions.desc: Grihoo unleashes a flurry of bites in its vicinity, making one bite attack against any number of creatures within 30 feet of it, with a separate attack roll for each target.

actions.name: Transpositional Swallow (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Grihoo chooses one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma saving throw or be teleported inside of Grihoo's stomach. While inside Grihoo, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Grihoo, and it takes 28 (8d6) acid damage and 28 (8d6) force damage at the start of each of Grihoo's turns. If Grihoo takes 60 damage or more on a single turn, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or expel all creatures that were teleported inside of it, teleporting them to a random space on the ground within 60 feet of Grihoo. If Grihoo dies, a creature that was teleported inside of it is no longer restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 60 feet of movement, exiting prone.

reactions.name: Counter Conjuration
reactions.desc: When a creature Grihoo can see or hear within 300 feet of it casts a conjuration spell or magically summons a creature, Grihoo interrupts the casting or summoning, causing it to fail and have no effect. Grihoo then regains hit points equal to 15 times the spell slot's level, if it interrupted a spell, or equal to the challenge rating of the creatures being summoned, if it interrupted a summoning.

legendary_actions.name: Bite
legendary_actions.desc: Grihoo makes one bite attack.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Grihoo magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Crushing Infinity (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Grihoo channels the overwhelming weight of infinity, crushing each creature inside of it. A swallowed creature must make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 5. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Enraged Casting (Recharge 4–6)
traits.desc: While the tyrannosaur has half of its hit points or fewer, it can cast one of its innate spells as a bonus action, even if the normal casting time for that spell is an action.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The tyrannosaur has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The tyrannosaur's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The tyrannosaur can innately cast the following spells, requiring only somatic components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Barkskin|barkskin]] *, [[Tools/Spells/Eldritch Blast|eldritch blast]], [[Tools/Spells/False Life|false life]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Hellish Rebuke|hellish rebuke]], [[Tools/Spells/Inflict Wounds|inflict wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]], [[Tools/Spells/Pass Without Trace|pass without trace]], [[Tools/Spells/Spike Growth|spike growth]]

*The tyrannosaur casts barkskin before combat

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tyrannosaur makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the tyrannosaur can't bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

sb.name: Grymhare
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The grymhare can use a bonus action to polymorph into a Tiny rabbit, or back into its true form, which is Medium. Its statistics, other than its size and its available actions, are the same in either form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.desc: The grymhare has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.desc: The grymhare has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The grymhare has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.desc: If the grymhare surprises a creature and hits it with a beak attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 14 (4d6) damage from the attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The grymhare makes one attack with its tentacles against each creature of its choice within its reach simultaneously. It then makes one beak attack.

actions.name: Beak (True Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite (Rabbit Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle (True Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 14) and the grymhare pulls it up to 5 feet straight toward it.

sb.name: H'rethi, Soul of the Desert
sb.damage_immunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious
sb.senses: blindsight 300 ft., tremorsense 1 mile, passive Perception 20
sb.languages: telepathy 1 mile and understands Common and Terran but can't speak

traits.name: Immovable
traits.desc: H'rethi can't move or be moved by any means short of a [[Tools/Spells/Wish|wish]] spell.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: H'rethi is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: When H'rethi fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: H'rethi has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Shattering Destruction
traits.desc: When H'rethi drops to 0 hit points, it shatters and is destroyed. Any creature on the ground within 30 feet of H'rethi must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) piercing damage and 22 (4d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: H'rethi makes three Soul Ray attacks.

actions.name: Soul Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) force damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Fortify (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: H'rethi gains 50 temporary hit points, and all attack rolls made against it have disadvantage until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Absorb Magic (3/Day)
reactions.desc: When H'rethi takes damage from a spell or other magical effect, it instead takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the damage dealt. H'rethi is still subject to any other effects that might accompany the damage.

legendary_actions.name: Sand Lash

traits.desc: The hammerhead has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.desc: The hammerhead can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The hammerhead has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) piercing damage. A swallowed creature is considered to be on the Ethereal Plane, it is incapacitated, and it takes 22 (4d10) force damage at the start of each of the hammerhead's turns. A swallowed creature can make a DC 16 Charisma saving throw at the start of each of its turns. On a successful save, the creature reappears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hammerhead. If the hammerhead takes 50 or more damage in a single turn, it must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which reappear in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hammerhead. The reflection automatically fails this saving throw if there are no other reflective surfaces within 60 feet of it. On a success, the reflection regains 10 hit points and uses its Mirror Step (no action required) as the previous reflective surface that contained it is destroyed.

traits.name: Unsettling Glare
traits.desc: When a creature that can see the reflection starts its turn within 60 feet of the reflection, the reflection can force the creature to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw if the reflection isn't incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature has disadvantage on ability checks and its speed is halved until the start of its next turn. actions.name: Mirror Step
actions.desc: The reflection teleports into another nonmagical, metallic reflective surface of its choice that it can see within 60 feet of it.

reactions.name: Magic Reflection
reactions.desc: When the reflection is the only target of a spell or other magical effect that misses it or whose saving throw it succeeds, the reflection reflects the spell or effect back at its source. The source must be within 120 feet of the reflection or this effect fails. The reflection uses the spell save DC, attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original source.
