actions.desc: Lothrem can use their Frightful Presence. They then make three attacks: one with their bite and two with their claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage, plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of Lothrem's choice that is within 120 feet of Lothrem and aware of them must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Lothrem's Frightful Presense for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Ensnaring Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Lothrem exhales enriching breath on the ground in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide, causing a thick wall of tangled, thorny brush to magically grow in the area. The wall is 20 feet high and blocks line of sight. Each creature in the area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 63 (14d8) piercing damage and is restrained in the wall. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't restrained. The wall remains until the end of Lothrem's next turn, at which point it withers and disappears. A creature restrained in the wall or one that is within 5 feet of the creature can use its action to make a DC 19 Strength check, freeing the creature on a success. For the duration, the area is difficult terrain, and when a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 9 (2d8) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: Lothrem magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than their own, or back into their true form. Lothrem reverts to their true form if they die. Any equipment Lothrem is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Lothrem's choice). In a new form, Lothrem retains their own alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Lothrem's statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except and class features or legendary actions of that form.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: Lothrem makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Lothrem makes a tail attack

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Lothrem beats their wings. Each creature within 10 feet of Lothrem must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. Lothrem can then fly up to half their flying speed.

sb.legendary_description: The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Lothrem regains spent legendary actions at the start of their turn.

traits.name: Justicar's Smite
traits.desc: When the mage-arbiter hits with any attack, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) radiant damage (included in the attack). If the target has any remaining spell slots, it instead takes an extra 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

traits.name: Legendary Spell Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If the mage-arbiter fails a saving throw against a spell, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The mage-arbiter has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The mage-arbiter is a 20th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18). It has the following paladin spells prepared:

- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Command|command]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Protection From Evil And Good|protection from evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield Of Faith|shield of faith]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]], [[Tools/Spells/Spiritual Weapon|spiritual weapon]], [[Tools/Spells/Zone Of Truth|zone of truth]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Fear|fear]], [[Tools/Spells/Remove Curse|remove curse]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Death Ward|death ward]], [[Tools/Spells/Locate Creature|locate creature]]
- **5th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Person|dominate person]], [[Tools/Spells/Geas|geas]]

traits.name: Variant: Mage-Arbiter with the Sword of the Spelldrinker
traits.desc:
The rank of mage-arbiter is known to be a notable mark of prestige, but only the most renowned of this rank carry the esteemed sword of the spelldrinker (see The Griffon's Saddlebag: Book 1). Such a mage-arbiter uses the mage-arbiter stat block, with the following changes: • It has a challenge rating of 16 (13,000 XP). • It has 3 uses of its Legendary Spell Resistance trait, instead of 2. • It has the Empowered Spellbreak and Nullify Atmosphere traits, as well as the Sword of the Spelldrinker action option (all described below).

- **Atmospheric Nullification.** While the mage-arbiter is holding the sword of the spelldrinker, any magical light, darkness, or atmospheric effect within 30 feet of it is treated as nonmagical and breathable.
- **Empowered Spellbreak (2/Day).** When the mage-arbiter uses its Spellbreak reaction, it can choose to automatically disrupt the spell if it is of 5th level or lower. If the spell is successfully disrupted, and it has a casting time of one action or one bonus action, the spell is absorbed into the sword of the spelldrinker. The mage-arbiter can release the absorbed spell as an action, using the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster, but it is otherwise treated as if the mage-arbiter cast the spell. The sword can only have one spell absorbed at a time.
- **Sword of the Spelldrinker.** Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage, or 9 (2d8) radiant damage if the target has any remaining spell slots.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mage-arbiter makes three attacks.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage, or 9 (2d8) radiant damage if the target has any remaining spell slots.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage, or 9 (2d8) radiant damage if the target has any remaining spell slots.

reactions.name: Spellbreak
reactions.desc: When a creature the mage-arbiter can see within 120 feet of it casts a spell, the mage-arbiter disrupts the spell if it is of 3rd level or lower, causing it to fail and have no effect. If the target is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, the mage-arbiter must first succeed on a Charisma check (DC 10 + the spell's level) in order to disrupt the spell. If the spell is successfully disrupted, the target takes 1d4 force damage per level of the spell that was being cast.

traits.name: Justicar's Smite
traits.desc: When the magebreaker hits with any attack, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) radiant damage (included in the attack). If the target has any remaining spell slots, it instead takes an extra 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The magebreaker has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The magebreaker is a 15th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It has the following paladin spells prepared:

- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Command|command]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Hunter'S Mark|hunter's mark]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Branding Smite|branding smite]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]], [[Tools/Spells/Zone Of Truth|zone of truth]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Fear|fear]]
- **4th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Locate Creature|locate creature]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The magebreaker makes two attacks.

actions.name: Halberd
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage, or 9 (2d8) radiant damage if the target has any remaining spell slots.

sb.name: Malfuriel the Betrayer
sb.damage_resistances: cold, fire, necrotic, radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

traits.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
traits.desc: Malfuriel is immune to the diseases described in the Bloodmire Diseases table.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Malfuriel's darkvision.

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.desc: Malfuriel knows if he hears a lie.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.desc: If Malfuriel fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Malfuriel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Forsaken Weapons
traits.desc: Malfuriel's weapon attacks are magical. When Malfuriel hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3 (1d6) necrotic damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Malfuriel's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). Malfuriel can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]] (self only)
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Blight|blight]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Fire|wall of fire]]

traits.name: Variant: Optional: Malfuriel's Weakened State
traits.desc: At your discretion, Malfuriel may be in a weakened state from his battle with Syre when the party first encounters him. If so, his hit point maximum is reduced to 109, making him a CR 9 encounter worth 5,000 XP.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Malfuriel makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage, plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Corrupting Touch (2/Day)
actions.desc: Malfuriel touches a creature, and that creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 hour. The charmed target obeys Malfuriel's spoken or telepathic commands. If the target suffers any harm, or receives a command to harm itself, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect ends for it, the target is immune to Malfuriel's Corrupting Touch for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Malfuriel moves up to half his speed.

legendary_actions.name: Greatsword (2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Malfuriel makes one greatsword attack.

legendary_actions.name: Accursed Step (3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Malfuriel magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Malfuriel can then choose one creature he can see within 5 feet of him. The target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Malfuriel regains hit points equal to the amount of necrotic damage dealt.

sb.legendary_description: Malfuriel can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Malfuriel regains spent legendary actions at the start of his turn.

sb.name: Merchant Lord
sb.languages: Common, plus up to three other languages

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The merchant is a 7th-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). They know the following bard spells:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Mending|mending]], [[Tools/Spells/Message|message]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Comprehend Languages|comprehend languages]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Identify|identify]], [[Tools/Spells/Unseen Servant|unseen servant]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Locate Object|locate object]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Glyph Of Warding|glyph of warding]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|sending]]
- **4th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Leomund'S Secret Chest|secret chest]]

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Magic Coin
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d12) thunder damage.

actions.name: Money Talks (4/Day)
actions.desc: The merchant enchants a coin in its hand with divination magic, which lasts for 10 minutes or until the merchant ends the effect early (no action required). For the duration, a creature holding the coin that knows at least one language can understand the meaning of any word the merchant speaks, and when the merchant speaks, that creature understands what the merchant says. Alternatively, the merchant can use an action to see and hear through the enchanted coin until the start of its next turn, using its own senses as if it were in the coin's space. During this time, the merchant is deaf and blind with regard to its own senses.

reactions.name: Chance (Recharge 4–6)
reactions.desc: When a creature within 60 feet of the merchant makes an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, the merchant flips a coin. If it's heads, the creature can roll a d8 and add the number rolled to the d20. If it's tails, one random creature within 60 feet of the merchant gains a d8, which it can roll and add to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Shapechanger (Mimic)
traits.desc: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into a keg, mug, vat, or other alcohol-related object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except when it polymorphs into an object it can choose to change its size to Tiny or Small until it polymorphs back into its true form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
traits.desc: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

traits.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
traits.desc: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary alcohol-related object.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.desc: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

sb.name: Mizanoros, the Black Iron Fulcrum
sb.damage_resistances: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Aura of Punishment
traits.desc: Whenever a hostile creature within 30 feet of Mizanoros takes damage, that creature takes an extra 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Mizanoros has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Mizanoros's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, Mizanoros can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Mizanoros fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Mizanoros wields Hatred, the Wrathful Edge, a sentient weapon with an Intelligence of 14, a Wisdom of 13, and a Charisma of 17. It has hearing and darkvision out to a range of 120 feet. The weapon communicates telepathically with Mizanoros and can speak, read, and understand Common and Infernal.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Mizanoros's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 22, +14 to hit with spell attacks). Mizanoros can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Poison And Disease|detect poison and disease]], [[Tools/Spells/Inflict Wounds|inflict wounds]] (as a 3rd-level spell), [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Enfeeblement|ray of enfeeblement]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Person|dominate person]], [[Tools/Spells/Fly|fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Mizanoros makes three attacks: one with its sting and two with Hatred, the Wrathful Edge. It can cast any of its at will spells in place of one Hatred, the Wrathful Edge attack.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d4 + 10) piercing plus 15 (3d8) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. The poisoned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Boil Blood (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Mizanoros attempts to magically boil the blood of up to three creatures it can see within 120 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 41 (6d12) fire damage and 41 (6d12) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that is poisoned by Mizanoros's sting has disadvantage on this saving throw, and a creature that doesn't have blood is immune to this effect.

actions.name: Hatred, the Wrathful Edge
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (1d12 + 11) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire or lightning damage (Mizanoros's choice). If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, Mizanoros gains temporary hit points equal to the fire or lightning damage dealt.

bonus_actions.name: Blood Transfer (3/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: As a bonus action, Mizanoros can cast the [[Tools/Spells/Vampiric Touch|vampiric touch]] spell. For the duration, he can repeat the attack on each of his turns as a bonus action.

legendary_actions.name: Hatred Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Mizanoros makes one attack with Hatred, the Wrathful Edge.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Mizanoros moves up to his speed.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Mizanoros casts a spell.

legendary_actions.name: Accursed Step (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Mizanoros magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Mizanoros can then choose one creature he can see within 5 feet of him. The target must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Mizanoros regains hit points equal to the amount of necrotic damage dealt.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Eldritch Heads (6/Day)
traits.desc: When Elson hits a creature with an attack, he can cause the target to take an extra 11 (2d10) psychic damage. Alternatively, as a bonus action, Elson can regain 11 (2d10) hit points. While Elson has at least one use of this trait remaining, he can't be surprised and creatures with the Pack Tactics trait gain no benefit from that trait against him.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Elson's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks), requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Alter Self|alter self]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]] (self only)
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|bestow curse]] (as a 5th-level spell), [[Tools/Spells/Compulsion|compulsion]], [[Tools/Spells/Glibness|glibness]], [[Tools/Spells/Mass Suggestion|mass suggestion]], [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]], [[Tools/Spells/Weird|weird]]

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Elson is an 18th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). Elson regains his expended spell slots when he finishes a short or long rest. He knows the following warlock spells:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]], [[Tools/Spells/Eldritch Blast|eldritch blast]] (4 beams, +5 to each damage roll), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Message|message]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]]
- **1st–5th level (4 5th-level slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Arcane Eye|arcane eye]], [[Tools/Spells/Blink|blink]], [[Tools/Spells/Charm Person|charm person]], [[Tools/Spells/Entangle|entangle]], [[Tools/Spells/Enthrall|enthrall]], [[Tools/Spells/Fear|fear]], [[Tools/Spells/Hypnotic Pattern|hypnotic pattern]], [[Tools/Spells/Mirror Image|mirror image]], [[Tools/Spells/Mislead|mislead]], [[Tools/Spells/Nondetection|nondetection]], [[Tools/Spells/Scorching Ray|scorching ray]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]], [[Tools/Spells/Rary'S Telepathic Bond|Rary's telepathic bond]]

traits.name: Variant: Ochre Elson with Morath, Scepter of the Soul Vortex
traits.desc:
Morath, Scepter of the Soul Vortex is an artifact born from a fragment of the Thousand Voices. At the GM's discretion, Elson can wield the scepter, causing the following changes to his stat block: • He has a challenge rating of 12 (8,400 XP). • He has resistance to necrotic damage. • He gains a +3 bonus to his spell attack rolls and spell save DC, including for his Eldritch Roar action option (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks). • He knows the [[Tools/Spells/Chill Touch|chill touch]] cantrip, and can cast the [[Tools/Spells/Finger Of Death|finger of death]] spell once per day. • He has the Bestow Greater Curses and Morath, Scepter of the Soul Vortex traits, as well as the Phantasmal Skull action option (all described below).

- **Bestow Greater Curse (1/Day).** When Elson casts [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|bestow curse]] he can force the target to make its saving throw with disadvantage. On a failed save, the target is simultaneously cursed by all four of the spell's listed options.
- **Morath, Scepter of the Soul Vortex.** The rod has 8 charges and regains 1d3 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. When Elson reduces a humanoid to 0 hit points, the rod regains 1 expended charge. While holding the rod, Elson can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save DC 20, attack bonus +12) from it: bestow curse (1 charge), circle of death (4 charges), confusion (2 charges), insect plague (3 charges), ray of enfeeblement (1 charge), or speak with dead (1 charge).
- **Phantasmal Skull.** Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) necrotic damage, and Elson regains hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Frenzy (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 120 ft., up to four targets. Hit: 22 (5d8) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or become stunned until the end of Elson's next turn.

traits.name: Empowered Undead
traits.desc: Any undead that is under Ogden's control has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead. In addition, it gains a +5 bonus to its attack and damage rolls, and its hit point maximum increases by 20.

traits.name: Leech (5/Day)
traits.desc: When Ogden hits a creature with his quarterstaff that isn't a construct or undead, he can choose to deal an extra 3 (1d6) necrotic damage and regain hit points equal to the number rolled.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Ogden is a 15th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Chill Touch|chill touch]], [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield|shield]], [[Tools/Spells/Unseen Servant|unseen servant]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Blindness/Deafness|blindness/deafness]], [[Tools/Spells/Mirror Image|mirror image]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Animate Dead|animate dead]], [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|counterspell]], [[Tools/Spells/Fireball|fireball]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Blight|blight]], [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|dimension door]], [[Tools/Spells/Greater Invisibility|greater invisibility]]
- **5th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Bigby'S Hand|Bigby's hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Person|dominate person]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Force|wall of force]]
- **6th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Create Undead|create undead]], [[Tools/Spells/Disintegrate|disintegrate]]
- **7th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Finger Of Death|finger of death]]
- **8th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Monster|dominate monster]]

actions.name: Leeching Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

bonus_actions.name: Grave Sacrifice
bonus_actions.desc: As a bonus action, Ogden can cause one undead under his control to drop to 0 hit points. When he does so, he gains 14 (4d6) temporary hit points.

reactions.name: Grim Revival (3/Day)
reactions.desc: Immediately after Ogden kills a humanoid, he causes it to rise as a zombie under his control, as if by the [[Tools/Spells/Animate Dead|animate dead]] spell.

traits.name: Militaristic Resolve
traits.desc: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Pegasus Training
traits.desc: The knight has advantage on ability checks and saving throws it makes to remain mounted on a pegasus. In addition, while mounted, the knight's normal and long ranges of thrown weapons are doubled (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The knight makes two attacks.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. (60/240 ft. while mounted), one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Lance
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit (with disadvantage if the target is within 5 ft.), reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Bonded Mount
traits.desc: The knight is magically bonded to its pegasus mount, which obeys the knight's commands. If the knight isn't mounted, it can use a bonus action to magically teleport onto its pegasus, provided the two are on the same plane of existence. When it teleports, the knight appears astride its mount, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying. While mounted, the knight can force an attack or spell targeting the pegasus to target the knight instead, and both the knight and its pegasus have advantage on Dexterity saving throws. If its mount dies, the knight can train a new pegasus to serve as its bonded mount over the course of one month.

traits.name: Celestial Favor
traits.desc: When the knight or its mount hit with an attack, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) radiant damage (included in the attacks below).

traits.name: Militaristic Resolve
traits.desc: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Pegasus Training
traits.desc: The knight has advantage on ability checks and saving throws it makes to remain mounted on a pegasus. In addition, while mounted, the knight's normal and long ranges of thrown weapons are doubled (included in the attack).

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The knight is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It has the following paladin spells prepared:

- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Bless|bless]], [[Tools/Spells/Command|command]], [[Tools/Spells/Protection From Evil And Good|protection from evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield Of Faith|shield of faith]]
- **2nd level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Branding Smite|branding smite]], [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|lesser restoration]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The knight makes two attacks and uses its Strike Order.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. (60/240 ft. while mounted), one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Lance
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit (with disadvantage if the target is within 5 ft.), reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Strike Order
actions.desc: The knight chooses one friendly creature within 60 feet of it. If the target can see or hear the knight, the target can immediately use its reaction to make one weapon attack.

actions.name: Heroic Rally (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The knight bellows a command, emboldening each creature it chooses within 60 feet of it that can hear it. Each target gains 15 (2d10 + 4) temporary hit points and becomes immune to being charmed or frightened for 1 minute.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The psybird doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.desc: The psybird doesn't understand any languages, but can communicate telepathically with other creatures it chooses within its telepathy range. This telepathy can convey emotions or fleeting sensory memories, such as faint echoes of sounds it has heard, or flashes of images it has seen.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hypnotizing Plumage (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The psybird attempts to vex nearby creatures with its psionic calls and dazzling plumage. Each creature within 30 feet of the psybird that can see or hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by the psybird for 10 minutes. When a creature becomes charmed by this effect, apply one of the effects below at random for as long as the creature remains charmed.

actions.name: 1 Hazy Sight
actions.desc: The creature is unable to see with any definition further than 10 feet from itself. The affected creature is considered to be blinded to any creature or object further than 10 feet from itself, as they appear to it only as blurry, amorphous blobs of color.

actions.name: 2 Confusion
actions.desc: The creature suffers the effects of the [[Tools/Spells/Confusion|confusion]] spell, though the psybird doesn't need to maintain concentration on it. The affected creature can repeat its save at the end of each of its turns, ending the charm on itself on a success.

actions.name: 3 Stupefaction
actions.desc: The creature suffers disadvantage on all attack rolls and ability checks it makes that use either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. The creature also temporarily forgets any languages it knows except for the one it has known the longest.

actions.name: 4 Dizziness
actions.desc: Any turn in combat during which the creature uses more than half of its movement speed, it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or fall prone. Each time this happens, the creature can repeat its save, ending the effect on a success.

sb.name: Purple Jam
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 8

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The jam can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the jam remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a mass of grape jam.

traits.name: Limited Spell Resistance
traits.desc: The jam has advantage on saving throws against spells of 1st level or lower.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The jam regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the jam takes necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the jam's next turn.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If the jam dies, it regains all its hit points and becomes active again in 24 hours unless its remains are eaten, destroyed, or targeted by a [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]] spell.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

sb.name: Refuse Golem
sb.damage_immunities: poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the golem remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary pile of garbage.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Stench
traits.desc: Any creature other than a refuse golem that starts its turn within 10 feet of the golem, must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of all refuse golems for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, plus 9 (2d8) piercing or slashing damage (golem's choice).

actions.name: Hurl Junk
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Missile Absorption
reactions.desc: When the golem is hit by a ranged weapon attack, it absorbs the projectile into its form. When it does so, the damage it takes from the attack is reduced by 11 (2d10). A creature within 5 feet of the golem can take an action to pull an absorbed projectile out of it with a successful DC 15 Strength check.

sb.name: Rocborne Chief
sb.languages: Common plus up to three other languages

traits.name: Guiding Wind (1/Turn)
traits.desc: The chief can deal an extra 3 (1d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack. Alternatively, when the chief misses with a weapon attack, they can reroll the attack roll against a different target; the new target must be within 15 feet of the original target and within range of the weapon.

traits.name: Windswept
traits.desc: The chief ignores any movement penalty caused by strong wind and they can't be pushed because of strong wind against their will.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The chief is a 13th-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15). They know the following ranger spells:

- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Feather Fall|feather fall]], [[Tools/Spells/Hunter'S Mark|hunter's mark]], [[Tools/Spells/Jump|jump]], [[Tools/Spells/Speak With Animals|speak with animals]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Animal Messenger|animal messenger]], [[Tools/Spells/Gust Of Wind|gust of wind]], [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|lesser restoration]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Call Lightning|call lightning]], [[Tools/Spells/Daylight|daylight]], [[Tools/Spells/Wind Wall|wind wall]]
- **4th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Freedom Of Movement|freedom of movement]], [[Tools/Spells/Ice Storm|ice storm]]

traits.name: Variant: Rocborne Chief with Nimbus, First Staff of the Thunderbirds
traits.desc:
A chief in possession of Nimbus, first staff of the Thunderbirds is revered, for they've been blessed by their ancestors' spirits. Such a chief is considered a 13th-level ranger and uses the Rocborne chief stat block with the following changes: • They have a challenge rating of 8 (3,900 XP). • They know the [[Tools/Spells/Shillelagh|shillelagh]] cantrip. • They have the Nimbus, First Staff of the Thunderbirds trait, as well as the Nimbus, First Staff of the Thunderbirds and Buffet (Nimbus Special Attack) action options (all described below).

- **Nimbus, First Staff of the Thunderbirds.** The staff has 8 charges and regains 1d6 + 2 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, the chief can use an action to expend some of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save DC 15) from it: [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|lightning bolt]] (3 charges), [[Tools/Spells/Shatter|shatter]] (2 charges), [[Tools/Spells/Spirit Guardians|spirit guardians]] (3 charges), or [[Tools/Spells/Wind Wall|wind wall]] (3 charges).
- **Nimbus, First Staff of the Thunderbirds.** Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit (+9 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.
- **Buffet (Nimbus Special Attack).** Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The chief makes two attacks.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.desc: The rot monster has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

traits.name: Limited Flight
traits.desc: The rot monster can only fly for up to 1 minute at a time. While flying, it has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws against effects that would knock it prone. If it ends its turn in the air after 1 minute of consecutive flight and nothing else is holding it aloft, it falls.

traits.name: Rot Wood
traits.desc: Any nonmagical weapon made of wood that hits the rot monster rots and deteoriates. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of wood that hits the rot monster is destroyed after dealing damage.

traits.name: Waste Scent
traits.desc: The rot monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of rotting food and other decaying organic matter within 1 mile of it.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: The rot monster touches a nonmagical object made of organic matter that it can see within 5 feet of it, causing it to rot and deteriorate. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw to avoid the rot monster's touch. If the object touched is either armor made of leather or hide, or a wooden shield being worn or carried, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held wooden weapon, it deteriorates as described in the Rot Wood trait.

traits.name: Desert Camouflage
traits.desc: The lizard has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lizard makes two attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. While poisoned in this way, the target takes another 4 (1d8) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. Each time the lizard hits the poisoned target with this attack, the damage dealt at the start of each of its turns increases by 4 (1d8). If the poisoned target receives magical healing or a creature uses a healer's kit on the target, the target can repeat the Constitution saving throw, ending the poisoned condition on a success.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spit Venom
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. Hit: The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) acid damage and 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

sb.name: Sand Spider
sb.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: The spider has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.desc: The spider can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Seize
traits.desc: If the spider has advantage on an attack roll and hits a creature that is Large or smaller, the creature is also grappled (escape DC 14).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

sb.name: Sanguinor
sb.damage_resistances: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Aura of Punishment
traits.desc: Whenever a hostile creature within 10 feet of the sanguinor takes damage, that creature takes an extra 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The sanguinor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The sanguinor's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the sanguinor can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The sanguinor's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks). The sanguinor can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Poison And Disease|detect poison and disease]], [[Tools/Spells/Inflict Wounds|inflict wounds]] (as a 3rd-level spell), [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Enfeeblement|ray of enfeeblement]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Person|dominate person]], [[Tools/Spells/Fly|fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sanguinor makes three attacks: one with its sting and two with its trident. It can cast any of its at will spells in place of one trident attack.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d4 + 8) piercing plus 13 (3d8) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. The poisoned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Trident
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Boil Blood (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The sanguinor attempts to magically boil the blood of up to three creatures it can see within 120 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 39 (6d12) fire damage and 39 (6d12) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that is poisoned by a sanguinor's sting has disadvantage on this saving throw, and a creature that doesn't have blood is immune to this effect.

sb.name: Scarapit
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 11

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: In the first round of a combat, the scarapit has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The scarapit has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Noxious Resilience
traits.desc: The scarapit can breathe normally in any environment, and it has advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as [[Tools/Spells/Cloudkill|cloudkill]] and [[Tools/Spells/Stinking Cloud|stinking cloud]] effects, inhaled poisons, and the breath weapons of some dragons).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The scarapit can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Subterranean Explorer
traits.desc: While the scarapit is underground, it always knows how far it is from the surface, it can't be surprised while it isn't incapacitated, and it has advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to track creatures.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage, or 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage if the target is surprised, and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

sb.name: Seed Coin
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 6

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: The seed coin is indistinguishable from a normal copper piece. However, a creature that has truesight sees a deep red aura radiating from the seed coin, and a creature within 30 feet of it that is under the effect of a [[Tools/Spells/Detect Poison And Disease|detect poison and disease]] spell senses the insidious nature of the seed coin and knows it is a plant creature.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The seed coin doesn't require sleep. If the seed coin spends 1 minute in direct sunlight or a creature spends 1 hour in direct sunlight while the seed coin is on the creature's person, the seed coin receives enough nourishment to sustain itself for one day. When the seed coin dies, it becomes an ordinary copper piece.

traits.name: Variant: Silver Seed Coin
traits.desc:
A rare breed, these seed coins bear an uncanny resemblance to a typical silver piece. Though less prevalent, they are even more potent than their copper kin. Such a silver seed coin uses the seed coin stat block, with the following changes: • It has a challenge rating of 1 (200 XP). • Its Intelligence and Charisma scores each increase to 14. • It has immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. • It is indistinguishable from a normal silver piece, and it becomes an ordinary silver piece when it dies. • It has the Innate Spellcasting trait below, which it retains after it becomes a seed coin pollinator. • The saving throw for its Infestation increases to DC 12, and it kills a diseased creature in a number of hours equal to 1d6 + the creature's Wisdom score, rather than 1d12.

- **Innate Spellcasting.** The seed coin's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). The seed coin can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components: • At will: [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]] • 3/day each: [[Tools/Spells/Comprehend Languages|comprehend languages]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]] • 1/day each: [[Tools/Spells/Locate Creature|locate creature]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]]

actions.name: Infestation
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 0 ft., one humanoid that has the seed coin on its person. Hit: The creature must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or its mind becomes imperceptibly infected with a disease until the seed coin is no longer on the creature's person or the creature dies. Creatures immune to the charmed condition are immune to this disease, and a creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this disease for the next 30 days. The seed coin's influence invades a diseased creature's mind, killing the creature in a number of hours equal to 1d12 + the creature's Wisdom score, unless the disease is removed. In half that time, the creature becomes charmed for the rest of the duration and refuses to part with the seed coin. If a diseased creature dies while the seed coin is on its person, it immediately regains all its hit points and becomes a seed coin pollinator, as the seed coin takes over its body. The seed coin doesn't gain access to the creature's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies while controlling a creature in this way. This infestation lasts until the seed coin pollinator dies, killing the seed coin.

sb.name: Seed Coin Pollinator
sb.languages: the languages its host knew in life

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: The pollinator is indistinguishable from a normal commoner, and it appears and sounds exactly like the creature it was before becoming infested. However, a creature that has truesight sees a deep red aura radiating from the pollinator, and a creature within 30 feet of it that is under the effect of a [[Tools/Spells/Detect Poison And Disease|detect poison and disease]] spell senses the insidious nature of the pollinator and knows it is a plant creature.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The pollinator doesn't require sleep. If the pollinator spends 1 hour in direct sunlight, it receives enough nourishment to sustain itself for one day. When the pollinator dies, it becomes an ordinary humanoid corpse.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) damage.

actions.name: Coin Spray (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The pollinator hurls a flurry of seed coins at one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (4d4) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, one of the seed coins gets lodged on the target's body (for example, in a pocket or a fold in its clothing).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The whale makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the whale. A swallowed creature has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the whale, and it takes 3 (1d6) lightning damage at the start of each of the whale's turns. If the whale takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the whale must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the whale. If the whale dies, a swallowed creature can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) thunder damage.

sb.name: Slumber Phantom
sb.damage_immunities: necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious
sb.senses: darkvision 300 ft., truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 21

traits.name: Enervating Aura
traits.desc: Any creature other than an undead that starts its turn within 30 feet of the phantom must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target falls unconscious for 1 minute. Whenever an unconscious target takes damage or another creature uses an action to try to shake it awake, the target can make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Ethereal Form
traits.desc: While on the Material Plane, attack rolls against the phantom are made with disadvantage unless the phantom is incapacitated. In addition, the phantom can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the phantom fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The phantom has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Spectral Enthrallment
traits.desc: Whenever the phantom reduces a humanoid to 0 hit points, the target dies and a specter rises from its corpse. The specter acts immediately after the phantom's initiative count and is under the phantom's control for 1 hour, after which time it vanishes.

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.desc: The phantom is immune to effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The phantom makes two Life Drain attacks. It can use its Dream Eater in place of one attack.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 36 (8d8) necrotic damage, and the target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken, and on a successful save, its hit point maximum is reduced by half that amount. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The creature dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Dream Eater
actions.desc: The phantom taps into the nightmares of one creature it touches. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be subjected to the effects of the [[Tools/Spells/Phantasmal Killer|phantasmal killer]] spell for 1 minute (this effect doesn't require the phantom's concentration). The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. An unconscious creature makes its saving throws against this effect with disadvantage, and whenever it takes damage from this effect, the phantom regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

bonus_actions.name: Ethereal Jaunt
bonus_actions.desc: As a bonus action, the phantom can magically shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

legendary_actions.name: Ghostly Swipe
legendary_actions.desc: The phantom makes a Life Drain attack. Before or after the attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Ethereal Banishment (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The phantom casts [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|banishment]] (save DC 20), requiring only somatic components and targeting a creature it can see within 5 feet of it. If the target is native to and currently on the Material Plane, it is banished to its corresponding location on the Ethereal Plane, instead of a harmless demiplane. If the target takes any damage while there, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the spell on a success. If the phantom concentrates on the spell for its full duration and the target is in the phantom's Enervating Aura when the spell ends, the target doesn't return.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the Thousand Voices fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Necrotic Absorption

traits.name: 3 Sorcerer

traits.name: 4 Wizard

traits.name: Turn Immunity

traits.name: Remembered Spellcasting

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Thousand Voices can use its Terrifying Visage. It then uses its Cacophonous Shriek or casts two spells of 3rd level or lower.

actions.name: Cacophonous Shriek

actions.name: Terrifying Visage

actions.desc: In dragon form, Vincent makes two attacks: one with his bite and one with his claws. In humanoid form, he makes two sickle attacks.

actions.name: Sickle (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit (+8 to hit with [[Tools/Spells/Shillelagh|shillelagh]]), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) slashing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage with [[Tools/Spells/Shillelagh|shillelagh]].

actions.name: Bite (Dragon Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw (Dragon Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Recharge 6) (Dragon Form Only)
actions.desc: Vincent exhales a plume of energy in a 25-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) damage of the type associated with Vincent's dragon type (see the Dragon Damage Type table) on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Change Shape (2/day)
actions.desc: Vincent uses his action to magically polymorph into a Medium dragon of any type of his choice (see the Dragon Damage Type table), or back into his humanoid form. When Vincent polymorphs, it gains 120 temporary hit points, and he can choose whether his equipment falls to the ground, melds into his new form, or is worn by the new form (if possible). He reverts to his humanoid form after 6 hours, if he dies, or if he falls unconscious. His statistics are the same in each form, other than his AC and speed, as noted.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Mark
actions.desc: The wyvernfly marks a creature it can see as its prey.
